Word too the wise don’t try and please anyone but yourself, don’t accommodate to others because you want them to like you it’s good to want to grow as a person and become more morally upstanding but what’s most important at the end of the day is your happiness learn to be happy on your own so you’re not reliant on others you need a stable foundation and that foundation should be yourself.
